mapper.select: SELECT sc.*, u.name as student_name, c.course_name, cl.class_name, c.semester FROM student_course sc LEFT JOIN user u ON sc.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON u.class_id = cl.id ORDER BY sc.id DESC
